newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia wool pile soon below 2 mln bales - WI.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia wool pile soon below 2 mln bales - WI.

text.p: Total sales by Wool International (WI) from the Australian wool stockpile in the December quarter currently amounted to about 133,500 bales, leaving only about 50,000 bales to be sold to fill the quarter's sales quota, WI director Charles Armstrong said.
Addressing the New South Wales Farmers' Association general council meeting, Armstrong said this put WI well ahead of where it had been for several of the last quarters.
Unsold stocks in the stockpile now totalled 2.055 million bales. "So we probably will break the two million barrier on stockpile holdings before the end of this quarter," he said.
Much of the recent sale of wool had been at above closing auction prices, Armstrong said.
Just over 4,000 bales had been forward sold for March, he said.
The stockpile debt had been reduced to about A$970 million at September 30, while the interest rate on servicing the debt was about 7.4 percent, he said.
